capabilities: export vault markdown files to rodin.fyi
generate an intellectual fingerprint with themes, questions, and mental models
run the export from a ribbon icon or command palette command
connect a connection code to evolve an existing Rodin profile instead of creating a new one
disconnect the profile from the plugin settings
extras: Privacy note in the README: vault text is sent to rodin.fyi for processing and not stored permanently, only the derived fingerprint is kept; connection codes are as sensitive as the profile's management link. The manifest carries an unreviewed-plugin notice.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to analyze a whole vault for thinking patterns like recurring themes, open questions, and mental models.

requires.name: Rodin profile and connection code (for evolving a profile)

summary: Vault exporter that sends your notes to Rodin (rodin.fyi) to generate an intellectual fingerprint of how you think.
